failures.criterion: The architect's 1x gate: refusals within 0-0.1% of reads and 0.7-1.5% of writes on #2402 merged after #2392, three runs; a burst that is admission's, not a box-wide stall, is a failure (architect, 10:19Z)
failures.evidence: Local merge of #2392 7d09eefb into b18e2678 (32ea5013 in /legion/scratch/tmp/infra-592-tester/m2392: built on round 4's aaece0e0; one text conflict in store/pool.go comments; budget 89; build and vet clean, TestDispatchConnectionsPerPodIsTheServers passes), three 1x runs with a 1 s box-CPU sampler (/proc/stat, a shell loop independent of loadgen) beside each: g6-1x-c 0/0; g6-1x-a 0 reads and 4 writes (0.56%, inside the band), the burst at 10:25:09-15 straddling the window start, box sampler 60-82% busy with ticks 1.04-1.21 s; g6-1x-b 214 reads (1.99%) and 19 writes (2.64%), outside the band. The g6-1x-b burst is admission's: from 10:29:20 to 10:29:55 the box sampler ticked every 1.02-1.33 s at 53-89% CPU (no stall; round 4's burst had a 12 s sampler gap). Dispatch's /metrics at 10:29:36 shows read admission full, 28 in flight and 20 queued, requests pool 35 in use, 0 pool waiters, GC pause total +59 ms over 10 s; the refused reads fall between the 10:29:36 and 10:29:41 samples (cumulative read refusals 45 -> 263) and the refused writes are logged at 10:29:43-50. In the same window Dispatch's access log shows comment and edit writes taking 3.0-8.0 s and issue reads 3.1-3.3 s, and Dispatch logged at 10:29:48 'event horizon held back by an open transaction; live event readers wait for it' pending_for=5.38 s, holder a dispatch-requests backend 'idle in transaction' since 10:29:42.216 after 'select last_seq, project_key, pg_current_xact_id() from issues where key = $1 for no key update' (the event append's issue lock). The Postgres log shows no checkpoint and no statement over 50 ms between 10:29:28 and 10:29:50. So for about 15 s writes held their transactions for seconds with Postgres idle-ish, reads that wait on the event horizon or on those rows piled into the 28 read slots, and the 1 s admission wait refused the excess. Which wait held the write transaction idle is not established [INFERENCE: the 5.4 s idle-in-transaction after the issue lock points at work done in Go while the transaction is open, such as the document or ledger work of a write, or a wait on another pool]. No red test: the burst appears in one of three 180 s 1x load runs on the 2-core harness and has no deterministic unit reproduction; the evidence is the run directory g6-1x-b (dispatch.log, samples.json, TABLES.md) and boxcpu-g6-1x-b.txt in dispatch://INFRA-592/artifact/infra-592-tester-round6-tar-gz.
